scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.build:cloud: npm run build -w shared && npm run db:generate -w backend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.deploy:db: npm run db:push -w backend && npm run db:seed -w backend
